So the trail doesn't touch any blocks. That's why the blocks didn't move when I pressed LEFT.
I need to press RIGHT to extend the trail to touch the blocks. But when I do that, all three blocks move together.
Let me think about this more carefully. The key constraint is:
- All three blocks are on the same row (19-22)
- The trail is horizontal and touches blocks it overlaps with
- When the trail touches blocks, they move with the trail
- I can't touch one block without touching the others (since they're on the same row)
To swap N and Red, I need to:
1. Separate them vertically (move one to a different row)
2. Move one horizontally past the other
3. Re-align them vertically
To separate vertically, I need to touch only some blocks. But I can't do that when they're all on the same row.
Wait... what if I use the trail retraction mechanic? When I press LEFT, the trail retracts from the right. So:
- Trail touches all three blocks
- Press LEFT: trail retracts, all three move left
- Press LEFT again: trail retracts more, all three move left
- Eventually, trail no longer touches Blue (rightmost)
- Press LEFT again: trail retracts more, N and Red move left, Blue stays
- Press LEFT again: trail retracts more, N and Red move left, Blue stays
- Eventually, trail no longer touches Red
- Press LEFT again: trail retracts more, N moves left, Red and Blue stay
- Now N is separated from Red and Blue horizontally
But this doesn't separate them vertically. I need vertical separation to move blocks independently.

1. Press RIGHT to extend trail to touch all three blocks
2. Press LEFT until trail no longer touches Blue
3. Now trail touches N and Red only
4. Press UP to move N and Red up (Blue stays)
5. Now N and Red are at a different row than Blue
6. Press LEFT until trail no longer touches Red
7. Now trail touches N only
8. Press UP to move N up (Red and Blue stay)
9. Now N, Red, and Blue are all at different rows
10. Move each block to desired horizontal position independently
11. Re-align them vertically
